outputs.task: list 5 vegetables that grow well in the Netherlands in spring, with days to harvest for each
outputs.output: Vegetables that grow well in the Netherlands in spring include: Peas (harvested in 60-70 days), Radishes (harvested in 20-30 days), Lettuce (harvested in 50-70 days), Spinach (harvested in 40-60 days), and Carrots (harvested in 70-80 days). These estimates are based on typical growing conditions in the Netherlands, which benefit from a temperate climate and advanced agricultural practices, but actual times may vary with specific varieties and weather.
